# DevForge

> The most advanced free online developer toolbox — 13 pro-grade utilities in one fast, private, installable web app. Everything runs 100% in the browser: no signup, no server-side processing, no data collection, works offline.

DevForge packs the small utilities developers reach for every day — formatting JSON, decoding a JWT, testing a regex, checking a cron expression — into a single zero-dependency page.

Key facts:
- URL: https://gost-co.github.io/new-repo/
- Price: Free, open source (MIT license), no account required
- Privacy: all processing happens locally in the user's browser; data never leaves the device
- Works offline as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Zero dependencies, zero build step, no tracking, no ads

Tools (each reachable at `#/<id>` under the root URL):

- JSON Formatter (`#/json`): pretty-print, minify, validate and sort JSON with precise error positions
- JWT Decoder (`#/jwt`): inspect JWT header, payload, expiry and claims without uploading the token
- Regex Tester (`#/regex`): live JavaScript regex matching with highlight and capture-group tables
- Cron Explainer (`#/cron`): plain-English cron descriptions plus the next 5 run times
- Base64 Encoder/Decoder (`#/base64`): unicode-safe encode/decode with URL-safe alphabet support
- Hash Generator (`#/hash`): SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests via WebCrypto
- Timestamp Converter (`#/timestamp`): unix ⇄ ISO 8601 ⇄ local ⇄ relative time, with a live clock
- URL Encoder & Parser (`#/url`): percent-encoding plus a full URL breakdown
- Color Converter (`#/color`): hex/rgb/hsl conversion, shade ramps, WCAG contrast checking
- UUID Generator (`#/uuid`): cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers in bulk
- Case Converter (`#/case`): camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE and more
- Diff Checker (`#/diff`): line-by-line comparison of any two texts
- Lorem Ipsum (`#/lorem`): placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words

Source code: https://github.com/Gost-co/new-repo
